title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Eastern Visayas Science High School in Candahug, Palo, Leyte, to Philippine Science High School-eastern Visayas Campus

text.en: The name of the Eastern Visayas Science High School in Candahug, Palo, Leyte, shall be changed to Philippine Science High School-Eastern Visayas Campus.
The students of the Philippine Science High School-Eastern Visayas Campus shall enjoy the same benefits and privileges as the students of the Philippine Science High School in Diliman, Quezon City.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
